Id.description: Hyphenated 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal UUID, case-insensitive; no URN, braces or surrounding whitespace.

SafeString.description: Interpolated DSL string. Only {{data.identifier}} and {{vars.identifier}} dotted bindings are supported; arbitrary executable expressions are rejected. Never use for inert evidence or diagnostics.

JsonValue.description: Inert portable JSON. Strings are literal, including arbitrary braces and invalid DSL expressions; consumers must never evaluate or recursively interpolate this type.

Path.description: Origin-relative literal path: starts with exactly one slash; no backslash or C0/DEL controls. After DSL substitution the SDK must recheck the path and WHATWG-resolved origin against the frozen authorized base/allowedOrigins before any request/navigation, and enforce policy on redirects.

RuntimeCapabilitiesV1.description: VeriQ Runtime能力合同仅允许linux/x64、win32/x64、darwin/x64及darwin/arm64；Mac目标最低系统为macOS14，但合同接受不代表设备通过原生执行、进程监督、凭据或安装验收。

Timestamp.description: Supported RFC3339 profile: real Gregorian date, year 0001-9999, T/t separator, seconds 00-59, optional fractional seconds, mandatory Z/z or numeric offset (00-23:00-59). No leap seconds, spaces or surrounding whitespace. Emit UTC uppercase T/Z for server timestamps.

BindingJsonValue.description: JSON used only in interpolated DSL fields, recursively restricted to SafeString bindings.

DiagnosticText.description: Literal diagnostic/evidence text; retain invalid expressions verbatim and never evaluate or interpolate it.

hasPotentialWrites.description: Compiler-derived known write potential. Missing legacy metadata is UNKNOWN for retry safety.

retrySafety.description: Actual business request observation through Context closure. Missing means UNKNOWN; not sufficient without approved expected metadata.
